title: Amenemhat III
summary: King of Egypt's Dynasty 12, coregent with Senusret III.
description: King of Egypt's Dynasty 12, coregent with Senusret III. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (1586 BC ±1.5 years). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "The Aswan Canal of Senusret III and Merenre I"
reign.note: Start of Amenemhat III's coreign with Senusret III.

reign.date: Start Co-Rex: 1586; Start Sole-rex: 1575; End Sole-rex: 1542; Death or Deposition: 1539
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7A: A Chronological Baseline for Dynasty 12," OSF preprint of 11 Jun 2025 (no version number), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/GMX5J, file CFAH-7A Chronological Baseline for Dynasty 12.pdf, Table 3 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 12", p. 55
